warnings.title: ARTEX AI attack framework in widespread criminal and state use
warnings.text: Open-source AI agent framework used to scan targets, guess passwords at thousands of attempts a minute and abuse secrets leaked on GitHub, reaching cloud data within minutes. Public copies on Docker Hub (tomicdd/artex, congdonglinux/artex) were backdoored.
warnings.actor: ARTEX users (Storm-0940, VAPOR PANDA, Storm-3358, Crafty Falcon)

warnings.title: AntiFox attack tool built on ARTEX code
warnings.text: Attacks reported using AntiFox, a tool derived from ARTEX. Expect the same behaviour: bursts of automated requests, password spraying and leaked-secret abuse.

warnings.title: 10 newly exploited software holes this week
warnings.text: Project MONAI MONAI Label (CVE-2026-133968); N-able MailAssure (CVE-2026-134624); Apache Roller (CVE-2026-129448); Broadcom VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123890); SAP NetWeaver (CVE-2025-42884); Cisco Expressway Series (CVE-2026-76466). Update these products now.

watch.title: AI agents hunt GitHub for leaked secrets
